title: Publish a product playbook
summary: A playbook brings together how product work is done: principles, standards, templates and examples. Keep it short, living and easy to find.

beginner: Gather your standards, templates and examples.
Write a short introduction to how product works here.
Organise the playbook by the questions people ask.
Publish it in one place everyone can find.
intermediate: Add real examples from your teams.
Name an owner for each section.
experienced: Make the playbook the single source of truth for product practice.
Link it to onboarding and the career framework.
Open it to contributions from teams.

toolExamples.confluence: Publish the playbook as one space.
toolExamples.notion: Build the playbook as linked pages.

sources.title: The importance of a handbook-first approach to communication (GitLab Handbook)
